elements.description: Pick one or many options from a searchable, grouped list; picked options show as chips.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The picked values. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the list is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: creatable
properties.description: Offer "Create “…”" when nothing matches the typed text exactly

properties.name: createOption
properties.type: ((text: string) => ComboboxOption | void | Promise<ComboboxOption | void>) | undefined
properties.description:
Turns typed text into an option – defaults to { value: text, label: text }. May return a promise: the create
row shows that it's working, and a rejection shows an error there so it can be tried again

properties.name: maxVisibleTags
properties.description: Show at most this many chips, the rest as "+3" (Clean always stays one line)

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible label above the field (or use a page <label for>)

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: one entry per picked value

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Can't be changed or focused; also disabled inside a disabled <fieldset>

properties.name: required
properties.description: At least one value must be picked before the form submits

properties.name: invalid
properties.description: Shows the field as invalid (red edge, aria-invalid on the input)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The user picked or removed values ({ value, options }); cancelable

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The list opens or closes ({ open }); cancelable

props.name: options
props.description: Every option; icons and avatars may be React nodes

props.name: value
props.description: The picked values (controlled). Leave undefined to let the combobox keep them, starting at `defaultValue`

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values picked at first when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Every pick and removal, with the picked options

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the list starts open when uncontrolled

changelog: Lit 3 web components: `tc-button`, `tc-combobox` and `tc-data-table` (the pilot), `tc-look-provider` for an app-wide default look, the shared controllers (row window, focus rescue, smooth height, off-screen, on-screen, ARIA forwarding, hotkeys, rolling numbers). Pixel-identical to the React components in both looks and themes.

combobox `invalid`, otp-input `labelledBy`, stepper-form tags `autoComplete`, decision-tree Previous/Next buttons, inline-diff "Undo last decision", agent-plan Move up/down buttons, delegate-board click-to-assign.
